notes: Central eight-court tennis enclosure is confirmed by 2025 official venue notice. A 2026 international student guide says nine tennis courts campus-wide/main-ground; this unresolved scope discrepancy is retained in evidence. Satellite imagery inspected on 2026-10-09 shows two transverse green basketball courts and three red auxiliary rectangular courts in this strip. Acquisition date and auxiliary sport are unconfirmed; exact court dimensions remain inferred.

Theatre permanent canopy, stage flank walls, green basketball court and curved timber terraces are photo-grounded. Seven seat tiers, inferred bowl extents, stair risers and datum are visual approximations. No 2026 photograph independently confirming unchanged architecture was located; 2026 events only verify continuing use.
